description: Verify one Base mainnet USDC payment from its transaction hash: whether the transaction succeeded, the block and its timestamp, every USDC transfer in it (payer, payee, amount), whether a named address was paid, whether a named minimum was reached, and the EIP-3009 authorization nonce the settlement burned. A receipt is immutable, so the buyer can re-read the same transaction and check every field. Choose this when you must confirm one specific payment: whether a Base transaction succeeded, how much USDC it moved, whether it reached a named address, and which authorization nonce the settlement consumed. Do not choose this for a balance, an address history, a portfolio or any token other than USDC: it reads one transaction's receipt on Base mainnet. Example requests: Did transaction 0x0f7371af1e12c38802cb5cf278658d7c1d1b25f30005c27120efd5f8d8b49d84 pay 0x40505Da32d7Ecbf67cFC7F2F7CBf7d33EaBe223E at least 0.05 USDC on Base? | Verify this Base settlement reached my payTo address for the right amount. | Did this x402 payment succeed, and which EIP-3009 authorization nonce did it burn?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

minimum_amount.description: Optional: the smallest USDC amount that counts as paid, e.g. 0.05. At most six decimal places, because USDC cannot be paid in finer units: a finer minimum is refused rather than rounded down, which would verify a payment below it.

recipient.description: Optional: the address the payment should have reached. When given, the answer says whether a USDC transfer in this transaction reached it.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_usdc_payment_verify
title: USDC Payment Verification
